--- title: "[markdown_to_man()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Parse CommonMark/GFM and render as a groff man page. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/multimark/blob/main/src/multimark/_cmark.py#L477-L595){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python markdown_to_man( text, *, hardbreaks=False, smart=False, normalize=False, unsafe=False, footnotes=False, extensions=(), width=0, options=0 ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Produces groff-format output suitable for use with the `man` command or inclusion in manual page source files. Inline formatting maps to font switching requests (`\f[B]`, `\f[I]`, `\f[CR]`), paragraphs use `.PP`, and headings use `.SH` or `.SS` macros. The output is a fragment and does not include a `.TH` title header. Wrap it in your own man page structure to produce a complete manual page. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [text]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The Markdown string to parse and render. Must be a Python `str`. [hardbreaks]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Render soft line breaks as hard breaks (`.br`). By default, this is `False`. [smart]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convert straight quotes to curly quotes, `--` to en-dashes, `---` to em-dashes, and `...` to ellipses. By default, this is `False`. [normalize]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Consolidate adjacent text nodes in the parsed AST. By default, this is `False`. [unsafe]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Allow raw HTML to pass through. Since groff is the target format, raw HTML is typically irrelevant. By default, this is `False`. [footnotes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Enable footnote syntax parsing. By default, this is `False`. [extensions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Sequence[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [()
]{.doc-parameter-default} : A sequence of GFM extension names to enable. Valid names are `"table"`, `"strikethrough"`, `"autolink"`, `"tagfilter"`, and `"tasklist"`. [width]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The column at which to wrap output lines. Set to `0` (the default) to disable line wrapping entirely. [options]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : An integer bitmask of `Options` flags (e.g., `Options.SMART | Options.UNSAFE`). Merged via OR with any boolean keyword arguments set to `True`. Defaults to `0`. ::: ## Keyword Arguments Vs. Options Flags {.doc-keyword-arguments-vs-options-flags} The boolean keyword arguments (`smart`, `unsafe`, `hardbreaks`, etc.) are convenience shortcuts for the most common `Options` flags. When both styles are provided, they are merged via OR. See `markdown_to_html()` for a detailed explanation. ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The rendered groff man page string. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Render a paragraph with bold and italic: ::: {#88e363be .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from multimark import markdown_to_man markdown_to_man("**bold** and *italic*") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` '.PP\n\\f[B]bold\\f[] and \\f[I]italic\\f[]\n' ``` ::: ::: Render a heading: ::: {#ce6c93ce .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} markdown_to_man("## Options") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` '.SS\nOptions\n' ``` ::: ::: Wrap at 72 columns: ::: {#706522ae .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} long_paragraph = "This is a long paragraph of text. " * 10 print(markdown_to_man(long_paragraph, width=72)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` .PP This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. This is a long paragraph of text. ``` ::: :::
